column4: dialect-gated: engine/a_tenant_instance_timeout_below_the_floor_is_refused_test.go reaches PostgresStore.WriteTenantSettings through postgresOnly, which skips when no PostgreSQL is configured. tenant_settings has one Go writer and it is Postgres-only (cmd/cleatctl/ported.go declares set-tenant-setting {"postgres"}); MySQL and SQL Server only read.
